# Local single run


```{r}
source("sim/local/single.R")
```

```{r}
ctrl <- bhcrr_cv_control(nfolds = 3, ncv = 1,
          fit_args = list(maxit = 20L, epsilon = 1e-3))
```

```{r}
result <- run_single("sim/scenarios/troubleshoot.01.R", p = 200, run_id = 1,
                     fit_control = ctrl, s0_seq = c(0.04, 0.08),
                     s1_seq = c(0.4, 0.8), max_widen = 0L)
```

# Sending this on chpc

```         
./sim/chpc/run_sim.sh \
    scenario=troubleshoot.01 \
    npredictors=200,1000 \
    run_start=1 run_end=50
```

# Checking the equalblocks.01 event mix

```{r}
source("sim/R/load.r")
load_sim()

s <- scenario_from_file("sim/scenarios/equalblocks.01.R")

# Same seed the real run 1 at p = 1000 will use
set.seed(.derive_seed(s$name, 1000L, 1L))
d <- sim_data(s, p = 1000L)
d$design_settings$event_mix
```

```{r}
mix <- t(sapply(1:20, function(r) {
  set.seed(.derive_seed(s$name, 1000L, r))
  sim_data(s, p = 1000L)$design_settings$event_mix
}))
round(summary(mix), 3)
```
